title: Fit the documents to the question
statement: Every document in a set bears on its question, together they cover the time and place it asks about, and their differing viewpoints support more than one defensible argument.
detail: Failures of document tasks in public runs were repaired by adding missing decades and dissenting documents to foreign-policy rows, and by replacing documents on the wrong aspect of a question, such as social and global legacy documents on a route about why one side won (delivery notes of 24 May 2026). One task rose from 0.55 to 0.70 to 1.0 after, among other changes, documents from an under-represented perspective were added (23 May 2026). Their distinct provenance and opposing points of view, dissent included, are what make more than one argument possible, since a redundant, one-sided or neutral, list-like set fails.
against: The repairs were checked on the same public items they were made against: "Public failures were repaired before delivery, including Second Great Awakening causation routing, foreign-policy coverage/dissent" (aptraining-local/den-of-ideation/to_main/2026-05-24T0208Z_DEN_REQUEST_validate_unit4_dbq_solver_v1.md, line 30). Only five items, and a spot check of the set with the 14-year gap found that an invented document alone failed it in another model's run: "Doc 4 alone is sufficient to fail this DBQ." (icloud-work/aptraining/workspace/comms/_deprecated/outboxes/from_atlas/2026-05-04T1430Z_v40h_spot_verify.md, 138)

| 60433 | c_01hF | Documents only cover 1960-1966 but prompt asks 1960-1980 (missing 14 years) | 0.55 | 0.49 | 0.26 |

**Pattern:** Every chronic fail is a DBQ with either (a) fabricated primary-source attribution/date, or (b) severe temporal/geographic omission in the document set. These are data-veracity bound — the model invents or truncates documents.
Doc 4 alone is sufficient to fail this DBQ.
- Score 1.0: Every document can be used to support, complicate, or inform an analysis related to the prompt
- Score 0.0: All documents point to one obvious conclusion; no real analysis or argumentation is possible
- Score 1.0: Multiple documents have clear perspective, purpose, or context that students can analyze; sourcing/analysis opportunities exist
- DBQ `medium-7`: individual-liberties document pack was accurate but redundant and one-sided.
rows 61-62 DBQ hard/medium failed because the documents were too neutral and list-like for sourcing analysis,
